about_the_game:
Before Exit: Gas Station Soundtrack

Close the doors, turn off the lights, and let the silence take over.
This haunting collection of ambient tracks captures the uneasy calm of a night at the edge of nowhere.
From flickering neon to distant footsteps in the dark, each piece echoes the tension, mystery, and solitude of your last shift.

Immerse yourself once more - before going home.
